# FMEA acceptance fixture

`gas_turbine_fmea_review_sample_v1.csv` is a manually curated, de-identified
acceptance sample for exercising the governed M5 review and export contract. It
is not a production risk assessment and intentionally contains no S/O/D or RPN
scores. Each row contains the expected professional fields plus a source excerpt
and page locator so tests can verify field-to-original-evidence resolution.
